df40_eval_subset.source: DF40 test split, ungated repackaging; see assets/manifest.yaml
df40_eval_subset.caveat: Guard-waived: one unlabelled compression level, one unknown generator. Not a leave-one-generator-out result.

blend_seam.weights: fitted on 9974 FairFace crops, 19948 self-blended samples
blend_seam.note: INVERTED, not merely weak: ranks real frames as more fake than fakes. Refitting on the eval corpus's own reals gives 0.344, so it is not domain shift. Slot A finds composite boundaries; three quarters of DF40 has none.

npr.note: No weights on this deployment. Abstains with weights_absent.

effnet_b4.note: No weights on this deployment. Abstains with weights_absent. The obtainable weights (SBI, DeepfakeBench) are NonCommercial and FF++-derived; see assets/manifest.yaml.

dima806_vit.note: Measured at chance and saturated: mean P(fake) 0.961 on reals against 0.952 on fakes. NOT WIRED into the registry, deliberately — a detector at chance adds a dependency and no information.
